integrity: The combinatorial classification and angular formula are supported by an exact Q(sqrt(5)) arithmetic checker; numerical areas are supplemental. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Generic Haar-uniform central planes for regular planar-faced truncated icosahedra only; nongeneric planes and offset sections excluded. Only the eighteen-sided event has a closed-form probability; the other nine joint classes are listed with numerical spherical-area values. Historical priority is not independently confirmed.
title: Sharp eighteen-sided central sections of the regular truncated icosahedron
